query:
UPDATE subscriptions SET
               status               = $2,
               current_period_end   = $3,
               cancel_at_period_end = $4,
               last_event_id        = $5,
               last_event_at        = $6,
               updated_at           = now()
           WHERE subscription_id = $1
             AND (last_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM $5)
             AND (last_event_at IS NULL OR last_event_at <= $6)
